text: i am trying to learn english .
hi! i am here to help you.
that sounds great! what would you like to learn about?
i am from a small town in the countryside. how do you like it?
it is very beautiful with lots of green fields and trees. what about your hometown?
it has mountains, lakes, and forests. nice to be surrounded by nature. yours must have similar views.
i agree, it’s a paradise! but i don’t think it can beat the charm of our small town. what do you like about it?
the people and food are very delicious here. they know how to prepare traditional dishes with love. yours must have similar specialties too.
i can’t wait to taste those local delicacies! what kind of food do you like?
i love seafood and spicy curries. your cuisine sounds interesting as well.
that’s amazing, i’ll have to try it sometime. good luck with your learning journey! see you soon!
thank you so much! see you around then! goodbye!
